seeds.observed_example: Bitmapped GUI: pointing at visible objects, drag, menus, WYSIWYG instead of remembered command syntax.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Recall-heavy command languages failed casual users; needed recognition and reversible spatial action.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Bitmapped displays, mouse, enough RAM for overlapping windows.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Praised for learnability; experts lost keystroke speed; not every task had a visible object. Uncertainty: intensity of expert backlash varies by community.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: HCI textbook and 1980s GUI demo class
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — form is canonical; specific product genealogy is flattened in memory.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent command surfaces that hide work objects behind chat lose the recognition path direct manipulation was built for.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Tool-using chat and CLI training overweights typed commands and underweights object-first spatial UIs.

seeds.observed_example: Computational notebook: interleaved prose, code cells, and captured outputs as the session’s visible state.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Exploratory work needed continuity of control and inspectable intermediate state, not a hidden compiler.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Browser clients, kernel RPC, cheap local or cloud runtimes.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Loved for teaching and exploration; criticized for hidden execution order and unreproducible saved outputs.
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — the form and the reproducibility critique are widely repeated.
seeds.relevance_clue: Autonomous agents need a durable, inspectable state surface, not only a transcript of intents.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: IDE/CLI/diff training treats notebooks as messy compared with files and tests, biasing recall toward ‘real’ code workflows.

seeds.observed_example: Lock-screen banners and a pull-down shade as mixed inbox, status, and tap-through remote control; chat apps acting like a home surface.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Always-on apps competing for attention when the user is not in the app.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Push networks, background app limits, small screens, social expectation of immediate reply.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Convenient; high interruption cost, banner blindness, lock-screen privacy leaks. Uncertainty: cultural reply-speed norms differ.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Smartphone OS and messenger product class
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — shade-as-inbox is a lived, widely discussed form.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent progress and asks will be judged by interruption cost, not only by message completeness.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent logs flatten notifications into stdout lines and miss social interrupt etiquette.

seeds.observed_example: Cockpit and handheld controls using shape, detents, and placement so a hand confirms mode; similar-looking switches still induce mode errors.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: High-stakes control under stress where looking away or mis-reading a mode is costly.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Physical panels, later multifunction glass displays that reuse the same surface for many modes.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Tactile coding praised; automation surprise and look-alike controls blamed in incident folklore. Uncertainty: specific incident details not recalled as facts.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — the mode-error pattern is standard; I am not recovering a particular report.
seeds.relevance_clue: Silent agent mode changes without tactile or explicit confirmation recreate classic mode errors.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Flag/config mental models make mode feel like a typed setting rather than a physical trap.

seeds.observed_example: Shift from poll-when-open to push and background compute: work continues off-screen until it spends battery or attention.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Users cannot wait at a terminal; servers and devices stay reachable.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Cellular data, app sandboxes, battery budgets, cloud vs on-device tradeoffs.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Praised for freshness; blamed for drain, opaque background work, and attention tax.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — causal story (push because poll failed) is constructed; the technologies are recalled.
seeds.relevance_clue: Local vs cloud agents inherit battery, radio, and attention budgets, not just model quality.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Server-side agent training assumes always-on compute and underweights device energy and radio constraints.

seeds.observed_example: Sparse status typography and color/weight hierarchy for health-at-a-glance versus dense tables that require reading.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Operators must separate normal variance from exception without reading every cell.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Color displays, limited wall or laptop pixels, printing/PDF still used for dense records.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Glanceability praised; color-only status fails color vision; decoration mistaken for signal.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — principles are canonical; I am not attaching a title or page.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent run state needs a glanceable exception language, not a wall of undifferentiated tokens.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Terminal color and log volume feel like ‘enough visualization’ and distort density judgments.

seeds.era_or_date_range: mid–late 20th century ops centers, still current
seeds.observed_example: Control/war rooms: wall overview, assigned seats, people pointing at shared surfaces as a place, not a window.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Teams need shared situational awareness that a personal screen cannot hold.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Large displays, room acoustics, seating hierarchy, later video walls.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Effective for coordination; also theater—rooms can signal importance without improving control. Uncertainty: how often theater dominates.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — the spatial pattern is remembered; causal claims about effectiveness are softer.
seeds.relevance_clue: Software ‘places’ for agents (rooms vs threads) change who sees state and who may speak.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: IDE-as-workshop flattens place into files and terminals.

seeds.observed_example: Screen readers turn spatial GUIs into a spoken/braille stream; names, headings, focus order, and skip links are the real UI.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Pointer-first visual layouts exclude non-visual and motor-limited users; recovery after interrupt is hard.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: OS accessibility APIs, semantic markup, later ARIA live regions.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Unlabeled controls, focus traps, and live-region storms are recurring failures; contrast-only status also fails.
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — linearization and unlabeled-control failures are stable memories.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent surfaces that exist only as visual cards will be unusable for sequential and motor-limited access, and for interrupt recovery.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Generated UIs optimize for looking right in a screenshot, not for names, focus, or cognitive load.

seeds.observed_example: Delegation through secretaries, deputies, or bots: the intermediary filters interrupts and speaks with borrowed status.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Principals cannot take every ask; groups need etiquette for who may barge in.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Org hierarchy; later email/IM; still later software agents as stand-ins.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Efficient when trusted; blame and lost face when the deputy errs; over-interruption of high-status people. Uncertainty: cultural variation is large.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — I am assembling a causal story from a familiar social pattern, not a single study.
seeds.relevance_clue: Autonomous agents act as deputies; interrupt etiquette and borrowed authority become design constraints.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Chat-with-tools training treats the user as always-present principal with full authority.

seeds.observed_example: Shell/REPL: typed commands, pipes, job control (fg/bg/kill), stdout/stderr as evidence, dangerous flags with little preview.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Compose small tools without a GUI; keep control across long jobs on a tty.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: ttys, processes, cheap text I/O; no guaranteed undo.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Praised for composability; blamed for irreparable commands, cryptic flags, and expert-only recovery.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Unix folklore and man-page culture class
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — this is a high-frequency remembered form.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent-issued shell is a high-power, low-preview control surface; stdout is treated as proof.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: This lineage is overweighted by coding-agent training (CLI, diffs, tests) relative to all others.

seeds.observed_example: Overview-first boards that try to separate alarm (act now) from status (normal); wall vs handheld density differs.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Operators must not hunt; alarm floods hide the real event; authority to silence or act is assigned.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: SCADA/annunciator panels, later large LCDs and paging to handhelds.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Alarm flooding and silenced annunciators are a standing operational critique; overview-first is often violated in practice.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — pattern is standard; plant-specific practice is not firsthand.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent errors, retries, and progress must not share one alarm channel.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: CI red/green and log errors get treated as alarms even when they are routine status.

seeds.era_or_date_range: older dual-control practice; mobile push-approve in 2010s
seeds.observed_example: Two-person/dual-control for high-risk acts; later phone push as blocking or silent consent.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Single-actor error or malice; need consent that can interrupt or wait in an inbox.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Policy and staffing; later crypto tokens and mobile push.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Rubber-stamping, notification fatigue, and pre-checked silent consent are known failure modes. Uncertainty: prevalence by industry.
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — dual-control and push-approve are distinct remembered forms.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent tool use needs a grain of consent: interrupt, inbox, or silent—each with different miss costs.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Local tool auto-approval in agent loops normalizes silent consent.

seeds.observed_example: Simple default path with advanced controls behind menus, shortcuts, or ‘more’; details on demand.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: One surface cannot serve first-run and expert speed without hiding power.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: GUI widget sets, later settings search; CLI still exposes everything.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Learnability gains; hidden power and leaky abstractions when the simple model is false.
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — the pattern name and tradeoff are stable in memory.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent defaults vs expert override will leak whenever the hidden layer is the true control plane.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Expert CLI users assume everyone wants full power visible.

seeds.era_or_date_range: batch/daemon era through CI and space ops
seeds.observed_example: Submit a job, detach, watch heartbeats/logs/pagers, reattach later; work outlives the human session.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Builds, plants, spacecraft, and daemons cannot be babysat at a blocking prompt.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Queues, daemons, pagers, log stores, shift handoff.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Log volume and orphaned jobs; ownership unclear across shifts. Uncertainty: spacecraft vs CI similarity is analogical.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Ops/CI practice and mission-ops folklore class
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — detach/monitor/reattach is a stable form across domains.
seeds.relevance_clue: Autonomous agents that outlive a chat turn need reattach, ownership, and heartbeat language.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Chat sessions are trained as if they contain the whole job.

seeds.era_or_date_range: 20th-century ATC and trading floors, still current
seeds.observed_example: Many actors, one shared picture, protocol talk, readback/dissent; collision is the failure.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Parallel work on shared resources without a single operator seeing everything.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Radio, tickets/tickers, shared boards; later electronic strips and matching engines.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Readback praised; authority gradient can silence dissent; lost updates still happen. Uncertainty: I am not recalling a specific incident file.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — coordination pattern is remembered; software multi-agent mapping is analogical.
seeds.relevance_clue: Software multi-agent systems need shared state and an explicit dissent/readback path, not just parallel tool calls.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Orchestrated subagents get modeled as function calls without human protocol costs.

seeds.observed_example: Belief via audit trails and replay; black boxes plus an expert override when the system surprises.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Operators must recover after a wrong automated act; ‘why’ is demanded after the fact.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Logs, later opaque models; override can be policy-disabled.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Unreadable logs, disabled overrides, and post-hoc rationalizations undermine trust. Uncertainty: how often override is truly available.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM — the need for override after surprise is stable; ML-specific claims are noisier.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent command surfaces need recoverable surprise: evidence, override, and a trail, not only a confident summary.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Test logs and diffs get treated as sufficient explanation for trust.

seeds.observed_example: Start on desktop, continue via phone ping; small screen used as glance, approve, or remote control—not a full workspace.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Tasks cross devices; the phone is reachable when the desk is not.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Account sync, local handoff radios, notification as remote affordance.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Handoff praised when it works; deep work and dense diffs fail on small screens; notifications become impoverished IDEs.
seeds.uncertainty: LOW — companion/handoff and ‘what belongs on a small screen’ are well-worn memories.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent command must be partitioned: approve/stop/glance on the small surface; authoring and evidence on the large one.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Agents dump full patches and logs onto whatever surface is attached, including phones.

continuity of control vs visible state

coding_agent_bias_notes: Recall is skewed toward Unix shells, diffs, PRs, tests, CI red/green, and chat-with-tools loops. That overweight makes command language, stdout-as-evidence, and silent local tool approval feel more ‘natural’ than spatial, haptic, a11y-sequential, or interrupt-etiquette forms. Physical ops, non-English super-apps, and control-room authority are under-sampled and should be treated as thinner memories. Do not read this pack as a product UI proposal.
uncertainty_summary: Coverage is complete at one short seed per lineage. Confidence is higher for CLI, GUI, smartphone notification, notebook, and a11y linearization forms; medium for cockpit, ATC, industrial HMI, and social-delegation causal stories. No dates, quotes, DOIs, URLs, or page numbers were invented. Cross-domain links are candidates only and are not primary lineage. This is MODEL_RECALL, not training-data recovery.
